definition: A speculative decoding method that drafts the next tokens in the feature (hidden-state) space rather than the token space, achieving high acceptance rates with a lightweight autoregressive head.
details: EAGLE trains a draft model on the target model's hidden features, exploiting the observation that feature-level prediction is more accurate than token-level prediction. It uses a tree-structured decoding strategy to verify multiple candidate continuations. The follow-up EAGLE-2 adaptively adjusts draft tree depth and width, further improving speedups.

citation.title: EAGLE: Speculative Sampling Requires Rethinking Feature Uncertainty
